title: Enclave contract
description: Four answers plus a review date, as defined in The Software Field Guide, chapter 'Segmenting the Estate': owner, trusted identity planes, border inventory, blast radius, and when the contract was last reviewed.

enclave.description: Name of the enclave. Must be unique across the estate.

owner.description: Who owns the enclave and answers for its contracts.

trustedIdentityPlanes.description: The identity planes the enclave trusts. At least one: an enclave that trusts no identity serves no one.

plane.description: Name of the trusted identity plane.

provider.description: What provides identities on that plane.

borderInventory.description: Names of the seams that make up the enclave's border. Each must have a seam contract somewhere in the estate.

data.description: What data the enclave holds that could be lost or exposed.

statedLimit.description: The stated limit of the blast, in terms you are willing to say out loud.

reviewedOn.description: Date the contract was last reviewed, YYYY-MM-DD. The validator flags reviews older than 365 days and dates in the future.
